description: Reg. § 1.199A-3(b)(1)(iv); § 199A(c): a QBI-flagged passive business with $20,000 of income, and a non-QBI passive rental with a $30,000 loss of which $20,000 is allowed against that income. Wages $100,000 and nonpassive K-1 income $30,000: QBI 30,000 + 20,000 = $50,000 → 20% = $10,000, under 20% of taxable income (130,000 − 15,750 = 114,250).
